text:
Type: wide lounge accent chair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom, reading nook
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: felt-like woven fabric upholstery, brushed stainless steel wire base
Colors: light warm grey, brushed silver
Shape: tall flat upright back, low wide seat with flared wing-like arms that slope down at the ends, loose seat cushion, crossed sled-style wire legs, sculptural body on a light open base
Feel: relaxed, sculptural, airy, inviting
Goes with: exposed brick, warm wood, white walls, brass or chrome accents; loft, modern or industrial rooms

Type: oversized leather club armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, den, study
Style: traditional, classic, rustic
Materials: distressed pebbled leather with welted seams and topstitching, loose cushions, dark turned wooden legs
Colors: warm saddle brown, dark espresso wood
Shape: rolled arms, loose back and seat cushions, deep wide seat, short turned bun feet, boxy body, roomy and substantial
Feel: warm, cozy, inviting, timeless
Goes with: dark wood and black metal tables, woven baskets, cream or blue rugs; classic, farmhouse or traditional living rooms

Type: low-arm upholstered accent chair
Use: lounging, reading, extra seating; living room, bedroom, reading nook
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: tweedy woven fabric upholstery with self-welt piping, dark stained wood legs
Colors: burnt orange with rust flecks, dark walnut brown
Shape: tall flared back that widens toward the top, low flared track arms, thick seat cushion, splayed round tapered legs, compact and upright
Feel: warm, lively, playful, cozy
Goes with: walnut wood, white lacquer, green plants and bold botanical prints; mid-century modern or retro living rooms
